The cutover inventory classifies every current computation site by semantic fact, owner, threshold, duplicate, and disagreement; contradictory definitions of one fact are resolved while distinct facts retain distinct thresholds. The owner exposes immutable projectNodeLiveness(nodeId, nowMs) results and per-node semantic generations, coalesces all known future semantic transitions onto one shutdown-safe timer through the readiness setTimeoutFn/clearTimeoutFn seam, changes generation only when projected semantics change, and lazily reprojects overdue deadlines before consumer reads. No readiness or planning caller computes heartbeat freshness, lease validity, repair freshness, transport grace, or another time-derived node-liveness verdict locally; planning concerns and planning-generation invalidation remain outside this Quest.
